ui.找到两边相同的等式 t ≐ t，删去它。: Finds an equation with identical sides, t ≐ t, and deletes it.
ui.找到两边结构相同的等式（都是「并且」、都是同一个谓词……），分解为对应部分之间的: Finds an equation whose sides have the same structure (both “and”, the same predicate …) and splits it into equations between corresponding parts: ?A ∧ ?B ≐ it rains ∧ it is windy becomes ?A ≐ it rains and ?B ≐ it is windy. ¬A splits as A → ⊥.
ui.找到两边都不是 ?-字母、结构却不同的等式（一边是「并且」一边是「或者」，或是两: Finds an equation with no ?-letter on either side and different structures (an “and” against an “or”, two different sentences …) and reports failure.
ui.找到只有右边是 ?-字母的等式 t ≐ ?A，改写为 ?A ≐ t。: Finds an equation with a ?-letter on the right only, t ≐ ?A, and turns it into ?A ≐ t.
ui.找到等式 ?A ≐ t（t 不含 ?A），而 ?A 还出现在其他等式中：把那些等: Finds ?A ≐ t (t free of ?A) where ?A still occurs in other equations, and replaces ?A with t there.
ui.找到等式 ?A ≐ t，t 含有 ?A 而不是 ?A 本身时，报告失败。: Finds ?A ≐ t where t contains ?A and is not ?A itself, and reports failure.
ui.找到等式 ⋀x. ?P(x) ≐ t：?P 的参数是受 ⋀ 约束、互不相同的变量: Finds ⋀x. ?P(x) ≐ t where ?P is applied to distinct variables bound by the ⋀ and t contains no other ⋀ variable, and solves ?P ≐ fun x => t. When ?P is applied to anything else (?P(ann), ?P(?t)), the equation is left unchanged.

ui.接入改写规则列表：每一轮用第一条相合的规则改写一处，逐轮重复，直到没有规则相合。: Takes a list of rewrite rules: each round, the first that fits rewrites one place, round after round, until none fits.
ui.接入改写规则：在第一个目标中，由外向内、从左到右找到第一处与规则左边相合的位置，: Takes rewrite rules: in the first goal, outside in and left to right, the first place that fits the rule’s left side becomes its right side, that place alone. A rule with conditions adds each as a new goal after this one. Given several, it uses the first that fits; if nothing fits, it fails.
ui.接入规则：规则的第一条前提与第一个目标的一条已知合一，结论加入已知；其余前提各成: Takes rules: the rule’s first premise is unified with one of the first goal’s hypotheses and its conclusion is added to the hypotheses; each remaining premise becomes a goal, placed first. Given several rules, it uses the first that applies.
ui.接入规则：规则的结论与第一个目标合一，第一条前提与它的一条已知合一，这个目标换成: Takes rules: the rule’s conclusion is unified with the first goal and its first premise with one of that goal’s hypotheses; the goal is replaced by the remaining premises, one goal each. Given several rules, it uses the first that applies.

ui.每行一步，从头开始依次执行（相当于先点「重新开始」）：\n add 文件:
One move a line, played in order from a fresh start (as after Start over):
  add FILE     put a file of the repository into the context
  list         put the file list into the context (a loop only)
  drop K       take entry K out of the context (entry 0, the issue, stays)
  call         call the model
  test         run the tests: the level passes when they all pass

ui.消去第一个目标的已知中所有的 ∃：外层没有 ∀ 的，像实例框一样取出那一样东西；: Removes every ∃ from the first goal’s hypotheses: one with no ∀ outside is taken out as the instance box does; one under a ∀ becomes a new function of all the enclosing ∀ variables (sk1(x) …). The hypotheses must be in negation normal form first.
ui.深度优先搜索：框内的元件对收到的状态走一步，再从得到的每种结果继续；一条路走到底: Depth-first search: the parts inside take one step on the state received, then go on from each result; each path is followed to its end before backtracking to the next, until no goal remains.
